questions.stem: A 16-year-old girl, who is taking antiepileptics, has had a seizure-free period of 6 months. She has no family history of epilepsy. Her EEG is now normal and she has a normal neurological exam and intelligence. What would your advice be?

options.label: A
options.text: Stop the treatment and follow up

options.label: B
options.text: Gradually taper the drug and stop treatment
